# Open Source Acknowledgements

MeedyaDL is built on top of many open-source projects. We are grateful to the developers and maintainers of these libraries and tools.

## Download Engines

| Project | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [GAMDL](https://github.com/glomatico/gamdl) | Apple Music downloader with lossless, Atmos, and lyrics support |
